tools.name: get_forest_stats
tools.description: Read-only. Counts of trees, groves, total and unique visitors, and traffic by class (humans, agents, bots, trees planted today).

tools.name: get_forest
tools.description: Read-only. Bounded summary of the live forest: counts per tree type, growth stage and origin, grove levels, and the newest trees (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: list_trees
tools.description: Read-only. One page of trees with cursor pagination, the same data as GET /api/forest?limit=. Pass nextCursor as cursor until it is null.

tools.name: plant_tree
tools.description: Plant one tree in the Shared Forest for the caller. One tree per visitor per day; repeats only add growth energy. The visit counts as agent traffic. Ask the user before you call it.

tools.name: explain_shared_forest
tools.description: Read-only. Returns the full agent guide as Markdown: growth rules, API, tools and limits.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Read-only. Final price for sponsoring N trees for 12 months: unit price, total in euro cents and discount. Call it before you tell the user a price.

tools.name: design_tree
tools.description: Turns a short wish (for example 'a silver birch with lanterns') into a premium tree design. An AI paints the tree after the call (about 30 s); the first painting becomes the tree. Returns design_id and the tree genome. Max 3 designs per caller per day. Show the result to the user before you order.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Read-only. Returns one design by design_id: genome, genomeHash and expiresAt.

tools.name: find_spots
tools.description: Read-only. Suggests free positions for N sponsored trees, optionally near a point. Pass the spots to start_sponsorship, or omit spots there and the server picks them.

tools.name: start_sponsorship
tools.description: Needs OAuth scope sponsor:write (a Shared Forest account). Creates an unpaid order for the signed-in user and holds the spots. It charges nothing. The total must fit the spending limit the user set when connecting. The order expires after 30 minutes unless the user confirms. Returns confirm_url: giv

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Read-only. Needs OAuth scope account:read or sponsor:write. Status of one of the user's orders (open, paid, fulfilled, expired, refunded, disputed, cancelled, refund_pending) and its tree ids once fulfilled. Poll every 10 seconds or more after the user pays.

tools.name: my_orders
tools.description: Read-only. Needs OAuth scope account:read. The signed-in user's sponsorship orders, newest first, with status, total and tree ids.

tools.name: my_trees
tools.description: Read-only. Needs OAuth scope account:read. The trees of the signed-in user's fulfilled orders, with a link to each tree in the forest.
